programs.description: Neela, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with Amol, who hails from a middle-class background. Trouble ensues when Vicky, an affluent young man, is attracted to Neela.
A simple cowherd, Honaji Bala, has an incredible gift for writing poetry and singing. He goes on to become a legendary Marathi poet and even contributes a lot to the field of music.
After suffering heartbreak and subsequently a failed suicide attempt, Mithu's friends try to cheer him up by helping him impress girls.
Jaideep and his family worship Goddess Tulja Bhavani. Taking advantage of their humility and innocence, Jaideep's friend, Kishore, dupes them and leaves them reliant on the Goddess' help.
Arjun regrets marrying his best friend Mary and blames God for his unhappy life. So, the latter offers him a second chance to rewrite his destiny.
Kandya and his six brothers live in poverty. However, their lives improve when Kandya marries a woman who shows them a new, better way of living.
